{{Gemini}}
Gemini 17 is the 185th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 17th day of Gemini, and it is a Wednesday. It corresponds to ISO week 27, weekday 3.

Its informal Japanese name is 7宮17日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 185|Chapter 185]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152205}}.
